villa.title: The Villa
villa.subtitle: A 3-bedroom villa over the Ria Formosa, for groups and multi-generational families
villa.description:
Imagine waking slowly in the master bedroom, opening the balcony doors and finding the Ria Formosa stretched out in front of you. The tide moving slowly, the light changing, flamingos passing in the distance. Go down to the deck for the first coffee, the same view still keeping you company.

Around lunchtime, walk a few steps down to the edge of the ria and catch the boat that takes you to the Island Beach in just minutes. White sand, no crowds, water that looks like a pool. Return at the end of the afternoon — BBQ in the garden, table set, the ria now at sunset.

A 3-bedroom villa on two floors, with a balcony in the master bedroom over the ria, a garden with BBQ and a deck with outdoor seating. Full kitchen, living room with fireplace, two bathrooms.

Designed for groups of friends, two couples, multi-generational families or work retreats. For those who prefer space and quiet.
villa.groundFloorDesc: Living room with fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, 1 bedroom with 2 single beds (90x200cm) and bathroom with shower.
villa.firstFloorDesc: Master suite with queen bed (160x200cm), crib and sea view balcony. Premium double room with double bed (140x200cm). Bathroom with shower.
villa.outdoorDesc: Garden with BBQ and sun loungers, master bedroom balcony overlooking the Ria, free parking.

location.title: Location
location.subtitle: In the heart of Cabanas de Tavira
location.aboutText:
Cabanas de Tavira is a fishing village that decided not to grow too much. A waterfront promenade with small taverns where the fish still arrives in the morning. Fresh seafood served without haste. Sunsets that look painted. A rhythm slow enough to make the first few days an exercise in slowing down.

Historic Tavira is 8 minutes by car; Faro is 50. But in Cabanas is where you stay — for everything else, there's no time.
location.highlightsSubtitle: The must-sees just minutes from Villa Solria. Insider tips and contacts in the exclusive guest guide.

iliaCabanas.name: Cabanas Island
iliaCabanas.blurb: Paradise beach with white sand, crystal water and almost no crowds. The ferry leaves from the marina just steps from the house.

riaFormosa.name: Ria Formosa Natural Park
riaFormosa.blurb: A unique European nature reserve: flamingos, salt flats, channels and barrier islands. Perfect for boat trips, kayak or paddle.

taviraCentro.name: Tavira Historic Centre
taviraCentro.blurb: Roman-Moorish town with castle, Roman bridge, churches and traditional taverns. A must at sunset.

praiaBarril.name: Barril Beach
praiaBarril.blurb: Famous for its Anchor Cemetery, reached by a tourist train across the Ria. Wide, wild beach with stunning dunes.

cacelaVelha.name: Cacela Velha
cacelaVelha.blurb: Walled village on a clifftop over the Ria. Breathtaking views, especially at sunset.

castroMarim.name: Castro Marim
castroMarim.blurb: Medieval castle, salt flats producing fleur de sel, and the famous medieval fair in August. 5 min from the Spanish border.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Check-in is done via a digital smart lock. You will receive the access code by message before your arrival. Check-in is from 4:00 PM.
faq.a2: Villa Solria has free parking next to the property. The street is quiet and there is always a space available.
faq.a3: A 700-metre walk (about 5 minutes) takes you to the boat pier across the Ria. The crossing takes ~3 minutes and drops you straight on Cabanas Island beach — golden sand and calm waters, perfect for families.
faq.a4: Unfortunately, pets are not allowed at Villa Solria.
faq.q5: Does the villa have air conditioning?
faq.a5: Yes, all bedrooms and the living room have air conditioning.
faq.q6: How do I get to the villa from the airport?
faq.a6: Faro Airport is 53 km away (about 40 minutes by car). We recommend renting a car or booking a transfer. We can help arrange the transfer.
faq.a7: Yes, the kitchen is fully equipped with a stove, fridge, microwave, coffee machine, air fryer, toaster, dishwasher and all necessary utensils.
faq.a8: We offer free cancellation up to 14 days before check-in. Contact us for more details about the cancellation policy.
faq.a9: Yes, there are mini-markets in Cabanas de Tavira within a 5-minute walk. For larger shopping, there are supermarkets in Tavira (3.5 km).
faq.q10: Do you provide bed linen and towels?
faq.a10: Yes, we provide bed linen and bath towels. Beach towels are not included — we recommend bringing your own.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What our guests say
reviews.review1Text: Modern and comfortable house with a lovely terrace. The beds are great. The kitchen is small but functional and well equipped. Quiet location with wonderful views of the Ria.
reviews.review2Text: A very nice spacious house in a quiet cul-de-sac with a magnificent view of the Ria Formosa.
reviews.review3Text: Villa with all the amenities for a holiday. Well located, about a 10-minute walk from the center of Cabanas. The owner (Bruno) is always available and helpful.
